dcm.categoryDescription: LK Group is a world-leading die casting machine manufacturer. According to statistics, since 2007, the sales volume of LK die casting machines has accounted for 50% of the sales volume of die casting machines in China, Brazil and Southeast Asia for many consecutive years. The group has been continuously selected as one of the "Top 500 Chinese Machinery Enterprises" since 2006.

models.name: AVISS II
models.description: Since the launch of the first AVIS machine in 1994, the hot chamber machine AVIS has become a representative of professional, high-quality and high-efficiency die casting machines. The newly launched AVIS-II series has a higher level of standard equipment and uses the latest servo energy-saving technology at present, with significant energy-saving effects. Currently, the AVIS-II series is a world-class hot chamber die casting machine.
highlights: World-famous brand servo motor pump system
New fully enclosed sheet metal structure

models.name: Classic V
models.description: The new CLASSIC-V series is a perfect masterpiece that combines mature die casting machine design technology and manufacturing processes with modern advanced touch control technology and precise hydraulic control technology. Its intelligent design is convenient for operation, easy to monitor, and has a fast and agile response, which is conducive to achieving high-quality fully automated production.

models.name: D Series
models.description: The most distinctive design of the LK D series die casting machines is that its injection mechanism adopts a highly stable and high-strength D-shaped structure design. The high-strength integrated casting D-shaped frame structure has strong rigidity, small platen deformation, balanced force, and effectively avoids stress concentration. The injection process is more stable and reliable. At the same time, the installation holes of the injection cylinder and the shot sleeve are processed at one time, with high coaxiality accuracy, stable and reliable product accuracy, and the injection speed is 9m/s. The standard servo energy-saving system is equipped, with fast die closing speed, high efficiency and strong rigidity.

models.name: IMPRESS III
models.description: The third-generation high-performance IMPRESS-III series cold chamber die casting machines are designed based on inheriting the traditional design advantages, rich manufacturing experience and mature application technology of LK die casting machines, incorporating the world's cutting-edge new technologies, new processes and new concepts. It is a new generation of die casting machines with faster speed, more stable performance, energy conservation and environmental protection.
highlights: Stable response of pressure charging system

models.name: IMPRESS PLUS
models.description: The IMPRESS-PLUS series die casting machines inherit the advantages of high yield, high efficiency, stability and durability of the IMPRESS-III series. Combined with new-era die casting process trends and production management requirements, it integrates intelligent injection control technology, casting quality control technology, efficient die closing transmission technology, intelligent die height adjustment technology and servo energy-saving technology.

imm.categoryDescription: LK Group applies the die-casting technology accumulated over many years to injection molding machinery, enabling comprehensive improvements in aspects such as machinery, hydraulics, and electrical control. It perfectly combines the power and speed of pressure casting with the precision of injection molding.

models.name: Potenza V
models.description: The POTENZA-V series servo precision injection molding machine is a new series of servo energy-saving precision injection molding machines designed and developed based on the R&D concepts of "energy saving", "efficiency" and "stability". On the basis of the various original advantages of the POTENZA-III series, the mechanical part design is further upgraded and strengthened to improve reliability and stability. This series adopts modular design for more convenient personalized customization.
highlights: High-precision injection molding unit, flexible module design
New electric pre-plasticizing interface, freely choose pre-plasticizing
The overall machine power is enhanced
Optimize and upgrade the electric pre-plasticizing technology
models.note: Figma's own hero mockup shows an erroneous Tonnage of 280-6000 (leftover DCM placeholder). Real value 80-850 verified live against lk.world.

models.name: Potenza III
models.description: The POTENZA series, with production technologies developed and verified repeatedly over many years, has good stability and high precision. It offers clamping force ranging from 800 to 14,800 KN, and is an ideal basic equipment suitable for various injection molding technologies and process applications, creating higher value for customers.
models.note: Figma's own hero mockup shows an erroneous Tonnage of 160-900 (leftover DCM placeholder). Real value 80-1480 verified live against lk.world, matches Figma's own body copy of 800-14,800 KN.

models.name: Potenza A
models.description: The LK POTENZA-A servo injection molding machine incorporates new technologies, new processes and new concepts on the basis of inheriting LK's traditional design concepts, making the overall performance of the machine more advanced and perfect. The user-friendly appearance and safety design in line with national standards make the machine operation safer and more reliable; the professional injection molding machine computer control system has a fast response cycle and is easy to operate.
models.note: CORRECTED: Figma mockup showed erroneous Tonnage 6000-9000 (leftover placeholder data). Real value from lk.world is 80-850.

models.name: FORZA
models.description: The FORZA series adopts a single-cylinder injection system, which has a fast response and high injection accuracy. The whole machine has a compact structure, a small floor area, a large mold space, and the clamping force ranges from 4500 to 70000 KN. It can excellently meet the requirements for components with high surface quality in the home appliance industry, high-precision parts in the automotive industry, garbage classification sanitation bins, pallets and turnover boxes in the logistics industry, and civilian industries.
highlights: More stable and faster clamping unit
Controlled by the European KEBA computer system
Synchronous nut locking mechanism, uniform distribution of clamping force
models.note: Spelling confirmed as 'FORZA' (not 'Froza' as in original Figma filename) per founder decision.

models.name: Elettrica
models.description: The ELETTRICA series adopts a brand-new high-drive system, combined with a professional control system, flexibly achieving precise and efficient injection molding. It has strong scalability, is equipped with a high-performance computer with an Intel X86 processor, and has an open international interface. The clamping force ranges from 1000 to 5500 KN.
highlights: Linear guide rails, low energy consumption, and precise control
Intelligent mold protection to ensure the safety of molds and people under special circumstances
Automatic lubrication, special grease, in line with the requirements of clean workshops
Special tie bars for injection molding machines
models.note: India sells base ELETTRICA only. ELETTRICA-E and ELETTRICA-S sub-series NOT offered in India (confirmed by founder).

models.name: Lena
models.description: The LENA series adopts a direct press clamping unit, with platen sliding in linear guides and high-precision closed-loop servo valves. It has a fast response, stable operation and higher efficiency.
models.sourceVerified: Figma export (not found under this name on lk.world)
models.note: IMPORTANT: Lena is a DIFFERENT series from VARIA (lk.world's Multi-component model). VARIA is NOT sold in India. Content sourced from Figma export only, not cross-verified against lk.world. JUDGMENT CALL: Figma's own hero mockup shows Tonnage 30-400, which does not match the 500-4000 KN clamping-force figure also shown -- every other IMM model in this dataset follows a ~10x tonnage-to-KN ratio, and Figma's hero stat has now been confirmed wrong on 3 other IMM pages (Potenza V, Potenza III, Forza/Elettrica) due to a recycled DCM placeholder value. Applying the same ratio here gives 50-400T, which is what's stored. No lk.world page exists to independently verify -- flag for founder confirmation if real spec sheets become available. machineType corrected from 'Multi-component' to 'Direct Press' to match Figma's own IMM filter-tab label and this model's own description text.

cnc.categoryDescription: LK Group established a computer numerical control machining center in Taiwan. It has developed more than ten products such as vertical and horizontal drilling and milling machines. A number of technologies have obtained patents in the Chinese mainland, Taiwan, China and the United States. The products have successfully passed the strict certification of Foxconn Group's Apple products and qualified production equipment.
cnc.note: No tonnage/clamping-force specs shown for CNC on lk.world -- consistent with our decision not to publish detailed specs (CNC uses different spec measures like table size/spindle speed anyway).

models.name: MV Series
models.description: Primarily designed for high-precision small and medium-sized parts processing, it employs high-torque motors to achieve high-performance cutting capabilities, widely used in mass production of aluminum and iron castings.

models.name: VM Series
models.description: Primarily designed for high-precision small and medium-sized parts processing, it employs high-torque motors to achieve high-performance cutting capabilities, widely used in mass production of aluminum and iron castings.

models.name: VC Series
models.description: The high-rigidity frame structure is designed with a robust base to ensure stable structural characteristics. The advanced spindle design utilizes high-rigidity bearings to deliver exceptional cutting performance and low thermal temperature rise. The chip removal system is configured for either front or rear discharge, facilitating rapid and smooth tool changes. The high-speed transmission features high rigidity, low friction, and reduced noise.
highlights: High-rigidity frame structure with a robust base

models.name: TC Series
models.description: Fast, space-saving, and easy to operate, especially for drilling and tapping processes, where its rapid and efficient characteristics are even more pronounced.

models.name: LH Series
models.description: Featuring high rigidity and high-speed processing, the LH-500 is lightweight. Its rapid feed speed is over 20% faster than traditional models, and the machine structure utilizes a rear-wall high-rigidity bed. From low-speed casting processing to high-speed aluminum alloy processing, it meets the diverse needs of various industries, led by the automotive industry.

models.name: HT Series
models.description: The interchangeable worktable can support up to 600kg. Coupled with the overhead crane-style structural design, it enhances repeat positioning accuracy and stability during rapid worktable exchange, facilitating maintenance and service.

models.name: GS Series
models.description: The GS series of compact machining centers combines the ultra-large strokes of large vertical machining centers with the high efficiency of drilling and tapping centers into a new type of machining center.

models.name: EU Series
models.description: The high-speed gantry machining center fully adopts European craftsmanship's high-specification technical indicators and assembly quality. It boasts exceptionally high cutting feed rates while maintaining superior precision levels.

models.name: GM Series
models.description: The GM series of CNC gantry machining centers inherit the advantages of traditional gantry machine tool processing. The design fully considers the internal reinforcement structure of each component, as well as high rigidity and dynamic characteristics, to meet the cutting requirements of high power and torque. It is suitable for processing materials such as ferrous metals, cast iron, steel, etc. Meanwhile, it can handle the processing of complex parts with multiple angles and five surfaces, catering to the processing needs of industries such as shipbuilding, mold making, engineering equipment, and rail transit.
highlights: Compact Fixed Table and Beam Design

models.name: MCG5 Series
models.description: Efficient processing solutions for large integrated structural components of new energy vehicles. Through digital twinning, precise verification of machine tool processing is achieved, significantly enhancing processing efficiency and safety. High speed, high efficiency, and high precision are integrated into one, specifically designed for aluminum die-casting processing of large and complex vehicle bodies.
highlights: Precision verification of machine tool processing through digital twin, greatly enhancing machining efficiency and safety

models.name: LT Series
models.description: The LT series of CNC horizontal lathes adopt an integral bed structure with the X-axis inclined at a 30-degree angle to the horizontal plane, offering a small footprint, compact and reasonable overall layout, smooth chip evacuation, and convenient operation. The guideways are rolling types, and the drive components use high-speed, high-rigidity ball screws, featuring fast speeds, low heat generation, and high positioning accuracy. The machine is fully enclosed for protection, with automatic chip evacuation, lubrication, and cooling. It is suitable for processing various complex-shaped axles, sleeves, and disks, such as turning inner and outer cylindrical surfaces, conical surfaces, arc surfaces, end faces, grooving, chamfering, drilling, reaming, and threading.

models.name: LTR Series
models.description: The LTR series of CNC horizontal lathes adopt an integral 45-degree inclined bed structure, occupying a small footprint with a compact and reasonable overall layout, offering high rigidity, smooth chip evacuation, and convenient operation. The guideways are rolling types, and the drive components use high-speed, high-rigidity ball screws, featuring fast speeds, low heat generation, and high positioning accuracy. The machine is fully enclosed for protection, with automatic chip evacuation, lubrication, and cooling. It is suitable for processing various complex-shaped axles, sleeves, and disks, such as turning inner and outer cylindrical surfaces, conical surfaces, arc surfaces, end faces, grooving, chamfering, drilling, reaming, and threading.

models.name: LTR-M Series
models.description: The LTR-M series of CNC horizontal lathes adopt an integral 45-degree inclined bed structure, occupying a small footprint and a reasonable overall layout, offering structural compactness, high rigidity, smooth chip evacuation, and convenient operation. The guideways are rolling types, and the drive components use high-speed, high-rigidity ball screws, featuring fast speeds, low heat generation, and high positioning accuracy. The machine is fully enclosed for protection, with automatic chip evacuation, lubrication, and cooling. It is suitable for processing various complex-shaped axles, sleeves, and disks, such as turning inner and outer cylindrical surfaces, conical surfaces, arc surfaces, end faces, grooving, chamfering, drilling, reaming, threading, milling squares, and milling keyways.

automation.categoryDescription: Provide injection molding and intelligent die-casting users with a full range of automation services, such as whole plant scheme planning, intelligent facilities, centralized feeding, robot design and production, whole plant virtual simulation and project control, and workshop digitization.
automation.note: JUDGMENT CALL (no Figma design exists for Automation -- confirmed by exhaustive search of the full export, category page and all 3 model pages): industryTiles below extrapolates the DCM/IMM/CNC pattern for visual consistency, using the same real photo assets (not invented). Set chosen to match what all 3 Automation models' own applicableIndustries data actually lists (Transportation, Smart 3C, Household Appliance), plus Industrial Supplies as a 4th tile for parity with the other three categories' tile count. Revisit if/when a real Automation design is provided.

models.name: LT04N
models.description: Equipped with a top-brand planetary gear reducer, reaching a back clearance of 0.05° for high precision of servo motor at maximum extension. High-precision linear guideways offer better abrasion resistance, longer service life, faster speed and lower noise. Internationally renowned synchronous belts provide better abrasion resistance, lower noise, longer service life, and better anti-corrosion/oil resistance.

models.name: LR 100 DP
models.description: In low-load applications, the LR series of multi-functional six-axis industrial robots offer advantages such as higher precision, shorter cycle times, and compact design. They require minimal floor space and offer flexible installation options, along with a low failure rate. Capable of agile operation in confined spaces, enhancing production efficiency and product quality while reducing labor costs.
models.note: Description is shared/identical across all LR-series variants on lk.world (LR20D/50D/100DP/165D/165Z) -- likely differentiated by payload/reach spec sheets not available to us, per our no-public-specs decision this is not a blocker.
